Coverage_Description: Single-premium participating life plan with guaranteed cash value (starts at 80% of single premium), possible terminal bonus (from year 3), guaranteed monthly income from month 13; death benefit at least 100% of single premium (less outstanding loan/interest); coverage to original insured age 151
pricing: Illustration shows US$500,000 single premium; guaranteed monthly income US$420 from month 13, expected non-guaranteed monthly income US$1,271 from month 37.
customer requirement: Underwriting approval; insured must be at least 15 days old at application
price structure: USD single-premium (lump-sum); same insurance rate for all ages, genders, smoking status and residence
additional informations: Monthly income can be paid out (bank transfer to HKD account or local USD cheque) or accumulated from policy year 11 at non-guaranteed inter; policy loan up to 80% of guaranteed cash value; insured can be changed unlimited times after policy year 1 (subject to rules)
